Drishtiदृष्टि · on-device visual perception

SIH26171·ISRO·Smart Automation

A lightweight agent that perceives a webpage the way a person does — from pixels, not the DOM — and acts on it. Runs locally by default: CPU-friendly perception with privacy-first optional server reasoning.

LIVE DEMOPIXEL → PERCEIVE → PROTECT → ACT
Privacy shield
Sensitive content is detected locally before any optional server reasoning.

What this demo is showing
The agent captures the visible page, scans pixels, draws detection boxes, protects sensitive information locally, grounds the instruction, then performs the browser action.
SIMULATION / PROTOTYPE

Pipeline

01
Capture
A headless browser takes a raw screenshot — no DOM or accessibility tree needed, so it works on any site.
→
02
Perceive
A quantized lightweight detector locates buttons, fields and text regions directly from pixels.
→
03
Ground
The instruction is matched to the correct detected element using on-device language grounding.
→
04
Protect
Sensitive regions are detected locally and blurred, masked or removed before optional network transfer.
→
05
Act
The local agent translates grounded coordinates into click and type events on the live browser instance.
